checks.interpretation: The matrix keeps component, observation, interface and conditional evidence separate; it documents the facility-QRA gate and does not open it.

checks.name: diagnostic_hazop_selection_event_binding
checks.interpretation: The audit confirms that every declared frequency event is matched to an explicit HAZOP component, operating mode, scenario family and release mode. A PASS does not qualify the provider release or promote facility IR/F-N.

checks.name: diagnostic_hazop_extension_mode_evidence_request
checks.interpretation: The request ledger makes every HAZOP-unbound extension event explicit and lists the runtime mode, reviewed scenario identity, equipment boundary, timestamp digest, and provenance needed before that event can enter automatic scenario selection. It never supplies those values itself.
